technical.summary: Mixed technicals with long-term uptrend structure but short-term overbought conditions and bearish stochastic cross limit conviction; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: BLDR shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying footprint, and minimal retail interest; elevated earnings volatility risk in 11 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (25/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and stale (185+ days), with no meaningful insider conviction evident.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (375.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 11 days adds binary event risk to already elevated volatility environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term uptrend structure (price above 200-EMA, SMA 50/200 bullish, supertrend bullish) with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear regime (VIX 375.2) offers asymmetric risk/reward for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary event in 11 days combined with VIX crisis regime, stochastic bearish cross, overbought Williams %R, zero fundamental conviction, and no triggered strategies create uncompensated event risk that outweighs technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term uptrend structure and extreme fear contrarian signal present, but earnings binary event in 11 days combined with VIX crisis regime (375.2) creates uncompensated event risk that violates swing trade risk/reward discipline.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 11 days during VIX crisis volatility will likely trigger sharp directional move regardless of technical setup, negating swing trade thesis.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
